items.title: 輝達重新超越蘋果 奪回全球市值王寶座
items.title_en: Nvidia Reclaims Global Market-Cap Crown, Surpassing Apple Again
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 週五 (31 日) 股價收漲 2.9% 至每股 200.75 美元，推升市值至 4.86 兆美元；在蘋果財報公布後股價重挫之際，輝達市值重新超車蘋果，奪回全球市值冠軍寶座。
蘋果先前一度登上全球市值冠軍，但週四公布財報後遭遇賣壓，週五盤中跌幅一度達 10%，尾盤收斂部分跌幅，市值降至約 4.51 兆美元。
另一方面，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 的財報與資本支出計畫，再度凸顯輝達晶片在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮中的重要地位。
亞馬遜將全年資本支出預測由 2,000 億美元上調至 2,200 億美元，同時淡化自研 AI 晶片與輝達之間的競爭關係。
亞馬遜執行長賈西 (Andrew R. Jassy) 在財報電話會議上表示，公司與輝達維持深度合作，並將繼續把旗下雲端運算平台 AWS 打造成運行輝達晶片的最佳環境。他指出，在可預見的未來，仍有大量客戶會持續採用輝達處理器。
不過，亞馬遜自研晶片帶來的潛在威脅並未消失。市場近期傳出，亞馬遜可能把原本主要供 AWS 內部使用的 Trainium AI 晶片直接銷售給客戶，進一步擴大與輝達的競爭範圍。
賈西證實，越來越多客戶有意在 AWS 雲端服務之外，單獨取得亞馬遜的 AI 訓練技術與晶片。公司正與相關客戶展開討論並評估可行性，他認為未來確實有機會推動這項業務。
儘管大型雲端業者持續發展自研 AI 晶片，輝達目前仍穩居產業龍頭，並重新成為全球市值最高的上市公司。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) closed Friday (the 31st) up 2.9% at $200.75 per share, lifting its market value to $4.86 trillion; as Apple’s stock slumped after its earnings release, Nvidia’s market cap overtook Apple’s, reclaiming the title of world’s most valuable company.

Apple had previously held the global market-cap crown, but after its earnings report on Thursday it faced selling pressure, with the stock falling as much as 10% during Friday’s session before narrowing the loss at the close, leaving its market value around $4.51 trillion.
Meanwhile, Amazon’s (AMZN-US) earnings and capital‑expenditure plans again highlighted the importance of Nvidia chips in the AI boom.
Amazon raised its full‑year capital‑expenditure forecast from $200 billion to $220 billion and downplayed any competitive rivalry between its own AI chips and Nvidia’s.

Amazon CEO Andrew R. Jassy said during the earnings call that the company maintains deep cooperation with Nvidia and will continue to make its cloud platform AWS the best environment for running Nvidia chips. He noted that, for the foreseeable future, a large number of customers will keep using Nvidia processors.

However, the potential threat from Amazon’s in‑house chips has not vanished. Recent market chatter suggests Amazon may start selling its Trainium AI chip—originally intended mainly for internal AWS use—directly to customers, further expanding competition with Nvidia.

Jassy confirmed that more and more customers are interested in obtaining Amazon’s AI training technology and chips outside of AWS cloud services. The company is discussing feasibility with those customers and believes there is indeed an opportunity to launch such a business in the future.
Despite large cloud providers continuing to develop their own AI chips, Nvidia remains the industry leader and has once again become the world’s most valuable publicly traded company.

items.title: 伊朗戰爭擾亂供應鏈 美兩大油商估柴油價格續漲至下半年
items.title_en: Iran War Disrupts Supply Chain, US Oil Majors Expect Diesel Price to Rise in 2H
paras: 艾克森美孚 (XOM-US) 與雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 在公布第二季財報後同步警告，隨著伊朗戰事持續衝擊全球能源供應，加上中國成品油出口減少、俄羅斯煉油廠停工及維修因素，全球柴油等成品油市場供應恐持續吃緊，下半年燃料價格預料將維持高檔，煉油業者也可望延續高獲利。
兩家公司第二季煉油業務獲利均大幅成長，主要受惠於全球燃料庫存持續下降，以及成品油供應受限推升煉油利差。
雪佛龍執行長 Mike Wirth 在法說會表示，柴油、取暖油等中間餾分油需求長期仍將保持穩健，因此產品價格第三季甚至更長時間都可能面臨上行壓力。
他表示：「我們預期產品價格將持續面臨上漲壓力，至少延續至第三季，甚至可能更久。包括柴油與取暖油在內的中間餾分油需求，長期來看不太可能明顯下滑。」
能源市場供應緊俏之際，美國汽油零售價格上週再度突破每加侖 4 美元，不僅增加消費者負擔，也為川普政府及共和黨帶來政治壓力。隨著 11 月美國期中選舉逼近，高油價可能成為影響選情的重要經濟議題。
為增加市場供應，美國兩大石油公司均表示，目前正維持高產能運作。
艾克森美孚指出，公司旗下美國煉油廠第二季維持高開工率，柴油產量創下歷史新高；雪佛龍則表示，美國煉油系統平均每日加工量首次突破 100 萬桶，同樣創下歷史紀錄。
不過，艾克森美孚董事長兼執行長 Darren Woods 表示，目前全球煉油廠維持高負載運轉的情況無法長期持續，若要真正改善供應，仍須恢復霍姆茲海峽的正常航運。
Woods 接受 CNBC 訪問時表示：「目前的高產能利用率無法長期維持，因此我認為全球煉油供應緊張的情況還會持續一段時間。」
他指出，艾克森美孚擁有中國以外全球最大的煉油布局，但原油供應中斷仍增加下游煉油業務營運難度。若霍姆茲海峽航運無法恢復正常，全球原油供應仍將持續受限。
兩家公司也提醒，煉油設備仍需例行歲修。雪佛龍預估，第三季歲修停工將使下游業務獲利減少 1.75 億至 2.25 億美元；艾克森美孚則表示，第三季歲修規模將較第二季減少，有助降低對獲利的影響。
財報方面，艾克森美孚第二季調整後下游業務獲利達 41 億美元，較去年同期明顯成長。不過，RBC Capital Markets 分析師 Biraj Borkhataria 指出，考量艾克森美孚擁有全球龐大的煉油產能，部分投資人原本預期公司可繳出更亮眼的煉油業績。
整體獲利表現方面，艾克森美孚第二季每股獲利略低於市場一致預期；雪佛龍則優於華爾街預估。財報公布後，艾克森美孚股價一度下跌約 1%，雪佛龍則上漲約 2%。
市場分析指出，目前全球柴油市場仍同時受到伊朗戰事、中國出口政策、俄羅斯煉油產能受損及庫存偏低等多重因素影響，即使國際原油供應未進一步惡化，成品油市場仍可能維持供不應求，使煉油利差與燃料價格在今年下半年持續受到支撐。
paras_en: ExxonMobil (XOM-US) and Chevron (CVX-US) warned after releasing their Q2 earnings that the ongoing Iran conflict, combined with reduced Chinese refined product exports, Russian refinery outages, and maintenance, may lead to a continued tight supply of diesel and other refined products, with fuel prices expected to remain high in the second half of the year, benefiting refiners.

Both companies saw significant growth in their refining business in Q2, mainly due to declining global fuel inventories and refining margins boosted by limited product supply. Chevron CEO Mike Wirth stated during the earnings call that demand for diesel and other middle distillates is expected to remain robust, putting upward pressure on product prices in Q3 and possibly beyond.

Wirth said, 'We expect product prices to continue facing upward pressure, at least through Q3, and possibly longer. Demand for middle distillates, including diesel and heating oil, is unlikely to decline significantly in the long term.' The US retail gasoline price broke above $4 per gallon again last week, increasing consumer burdens and putting political pressure on the Trump administration and Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections.

To increase market supply, both US oil majors said they are currently operating at high production levels. ExxonMobil noted that its US refineries maintained high utilization rates in Q2, with diesel production reaching a record high, while Chevron said its US refining system processed over 1 million barrels per day for the first time, also a record.

However, ExxonMobil Chairman and CEO Darren Woods stated that the current high utilization rate of global refineries is unsustainable and that a recovery in normal shipping traffic in the Hormuz Strait is needed to truly improve supply. Woods said in a CNBC interview, 'The current high utilization rate is not sustainable, so I think the tight refining supply situation will persist for some time.'

Woods pointed out that ExxonMobil has the largest refining footprint outside of China, but disruptions to crude supply have increased the difficulty of operating its downstream refining business. If shipping in the Hormuz Strait does not return to normal, global crude supply will remain constrained. Both companies also reminded that refineries require regular maintenance, with Chevron estimating that Q3 maintenance will reduce downstream earnings by $175-225 million, while ExxonMobil said its Q3 maintenance will be lower than in Q2, mitigating the impact on earnings.

In terms of earnings, ExxonMobil's Q2 downstream earnings were $4.1 billion, significantly higher than the same period last year. However, RBC Capital Markets analyst Biraj Borkhataria noted that some investors had expected more impressive refining results from ExxonMobil given its large global refining capacity. ExxonMobil's overall Q2 earnings per share were slightly below market expectations, while Chevron's exceeded Wall Street estimates. Following the earnings release, ExxonMobil's stock price fell about 1%, while Chevron's rose about 2%.

Market analysis suggests that the global diesel market is currently influenced by multiple factors, including the Iran conflict, Chinese export policies, Russian refining capacity losses, and low inventories, making it likely that the refined product market will remain tight, supporting refining margins and fuel prices in the second half of the year, even if global crude supply does not deteriorate further.

items.title: 美光前日暴飆18%後拉回！周五重挫5.9% 升息隱憂與獲利賣壓出籠
items.title_en: Micron's 18% Surge the Day Before Pulls Back! Friday Slides 5.9% Amid Rate‑Hike Concerns and Profit‑Taking Pressure
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 股價周五 (31 日) 回落，雖然蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 財報再度證實人工智慧 (AI) 使記憶體需求持續強勁，但市場對利率可能走高的擔憂，削弱投資人樂觀情緒。
美光股價周四股價大漲 18%，周五一度開高上漲，但後來翻黑，終場下跌 5.9%，報每股 823.03 美元。
三名反對聯準會 (Fed) 維持利率不變的官員，進一步說明支持升息的理由，這讓市場擔心，若利率進一步攀升，將抑制企業與消費者支出，進而衝擊美光產品需求。
美光周五也面臨前日大漲後的獲利了結賣壓，尤其近來市場質疑記憶體景氣榮景是否能延續，導致股價波動加劇。
不過，蘋果執行長庫克 (Tim Cook) 在周四盤後的法說會上，消除了市場一部分疑慮。他說：「我們預期 9 月為止一季的記憶體成本還會進一步上揚。」
《華爾街日報》(WSJ) 上周報導，蘋果正遊說川普政府，希望允許其在美國以外市場銷售的裝置使用中國製記憶體晶片。
不過，庫克周四僅保守提及未來可能增加其他記憶體供應商，並未表示蘋果計劃採購中國製記憶體晶片，用於中國市場銷售的產品。這代表市場擔心中國記憶體晶片大量投入市場衝擊美光一事，目前看來仍屬較長期風險。
在此同時，AI 基礎建設支出持續增加，也為記憶體需求提供支撐：亞馬遜周四將資本支出預估 由 2000 億美元上修至 2200 億美元，理由之一正是記憶體晶片成本上升。
華爾街目前仍預期，在 AI 投資持續推升需求下，美光未來至少三年獲利將持續成長。根據 FactSet 資料，美光目前預估本益比不到 6 倍。
paras_en: Micron (MU‑US) stock fell on Friday (the 31st). Although Apple (AAPL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) earnings once again confirmed that artificial intelligence (AI) is keeping memory demand robust, worries that interest rates may rise have dampened investors' optimism.
Micron’s share price jumped 18% on Thursday and opened higher on Friday, but later turned negative and closed down 5.9% at $823.03 per share.

Three Federal Reserve officials who opposed keeping rates unchanged elaborated on reasons to raise rates, prompting market concerns that further rate hikes could curb corporate and consumer spending and hit demand for Micron’s products.

Micron also faced profit‑taking pressure on Friday after the prior day’s surge, especially as the market questions whether the memory‑industry boom can be sustained, leading to heightened stock volatility.
However, Apple CEO Tim Cook, in Thursday’s after‑hours earnings call, allayed part of the market’s worries. He said, “We expect memory costs to continue rising through the September quarter.”
The Wall Street Journal reported last week that Apple is lobbying the Trump administration to allow devices sold outside the United States to use China‑made memory chips.

Cook only conservatively mentioned the possibility of adding other memory suppliers and did not say Apple plans to procure China‑made memory chips for products sold in the Chinese market. This indicates that market fears about a large influx of Chinese memory chips hurting Micron remain a longer‑term risk.

Meanwhile, AI infrastructure spending keeps climbing, supporting memory demand: Amazon on Thursday raised its capital‑expenditure outlook from $200 billion to $220 billion, partly due to rising memory‑chip costs.

Wall Street still expects that, with AI investment continuously boosting demand, Micron’s earnings will keep growing for at least the next three years. According to FactSet data, Micron’s current price‑to‑earnings ratio is under 6×.

items.title: 蘋果正評估中國記憶體供應商 盼緩解供貨與成本壓力
items.title_en: Apple Evaluates Chinese Memory Suppliers to Alleviate Supply and Cost Pressures
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 在最新財報電話會議中表示，隨著記憶體價格持續上漲，公司正評估不同供應來源，包括中國業者，希望藉此增加供應彈性。儘管相關計畫引起美國國會議員反對，蘋果現階段仍未排除任何選項。
蘋果指出，該公司今年第一季（截至 3 月底）的記憶體採購成本高於去年第四季（截至去年 12 月底），第二季（截至 6 月底）的成本又明顯上升。雖然庫存效益抵銷部分影響，但公司預估，第三季（截至 9 月底）的記憶體成本還將進一步增加。
在被問及是否可能向中國長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 採購 DRAM，以及向長江存儲 (YMTC) 採購 NAND 快閃記憶體時，蘋果表示，公司仍在檢視各種供應來源。引進更多供應商可望改善供貨情況，至於能否降低採購價格，目前仍不確定。
近期報導指出，蘋果據傳正在測試長鑫存儲的 DRAM 產品，顯示這家中國記憶體製造商未來可能進入蘋果供應鏈。不過，相關合作仍處於評估階段，蘋果尚未正式宣布採購決定。
《金融時報》先前引述消息人士報導，蘋果曾向川普政府爭取批准採購長鑫存儲的 DRAM。長鑫存儲因被美國國防部認定與中國人民解放軍存在關聯，目前仍被列入相關黑名單。
《彭博》記者 Mark Gurman 近期也透露，蘋果正與川普政府溝通，希望一旦決定採購長鑫存儲或長江存儲的記憶體，能降低在華府面臨的政治反彈。
根據目前傳出的規畫，蘋果若最終向中國業者採購記憶體，相關零組件將僅用於在中國市場銷售的產品。儘管如此，這項安排仍未能消除美國國會的國安疑慮。
一群美國國會議員已要求蘋果放棄採購中國記憶體的計畫，並要求公司在 8 月 21 日前承諾不會推動相關方案。議員同時要求蘋果完整揭露，是否曾向長鑫存儲或長江存儲提供技術資訊，以及相關資訊的具體內容。
從蘋果在財報電話會議中的說法來看，公司目前仍以確保供應穩定為主要考量，尚未因國會壓力排除中國供應商。不過，蘋果最終是否落實採購，仍有待公司進一步公布。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) stated in its latest earnings call that it is assessing different supply sources, including Chinese companies, to increase supply flexibility as memory prices continue to rise. Despite opposition from US lawmakers, Apple has not ruled out any options at this stage.

Apple noted that its memory procurement costs for the first quarter (ending March) were higher than those for the fourth quarter of last year (ending December), and costs for the second quarter (ending June) increased significantly. Although inventory benefits offset some of the impact, the company expects memory costs to further increase in the third quarter (ending September).

When asked if it might purchase DRAM from China's CXMT or NAND flash memory from YMTC, Apple said it is still reviewing various supply sources. Introducing more suppliers is expected to improve the supply situation, but it is uncertain whether this will lower procurement prices.

Recent reports indicate that Apple is testing CXMT's DRAM products, suggesting that the Chinese memory manufacturer may enter Apple's supply chain in the future. However, the cooperation is still in the evaluation stage, and Apple has not formally announced its procurement decision.

The Financial Times previously quoted sources as saying that Apple had sought approval from the Trump administration to purchase DRAM from CXMT, which is currently on a US blacklist due to its alleged ties to the Chinese military.

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman recently revealed that Apple is communicating with the Trump administration, hoping to mitigate potential political backlash if it decides to purchase memory from CXMT or YMTC.

According to current plans, if Apple ultimately purchases memory from Chinese companies, the components will only be used in products sold in the Chinese market. However, this arrangement has not alleviated national security concerns in the US Congress.

A group of US lawmakers has urged Apple to abandon its plans to purchase Chinese memory and demanded that the company commit to not pursuing the plan by August 21. The lawmakers also requested that Apple fully disclose whether it has provided technical information to CXMT or YMTC and the specific content of such information.

Based on Apple's statements during the earnings call, the company's primary consideration is still ensuring a stable supply, and it has not excluded Chinese suppliers due to congressional pressure. However, whether Apple will ultimately proceed with the purchase remains to be seen.

items.title: SpaceX跌破IPO價20%創新低 Starship隔熱罩只是眾多挑戰之一
items.title_en: SpaceX Plunges 20% Below IPO Price, Hitting New Low as Starship Heat Shield Poses One of Many Challenges
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周五 (7/31) 跌至上市以來新低，較 6 周前的 IPO 價格下跌約 20%。令人意外的是，這檔股票上市首日曾如火箭般飆升，如今卻迅速回吐漲幅。
SpaceX 周五收跌 3.4%，報 108.37 美元，盤中一度跌至 107.01 美元。當日標普 500 指數與道瓊工業指數分別上漲 0.7% 及 0.5%。
截至周五開盤前，SpaceX 股價已較 135 美元的 IPO 價格下跌 17%。
對投資人而言，股價自然是目前最關心焦點。但對執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 來說，除了資本市場外，他還必須克服一連串技術難題，才能讓 SpaceX 實現其終極願景。
馬斯克希望 SpaceX 未來能讓旗下 Starship 這款大型、完全可重複使用的火箭，每年發射數千次。這項目標極具雄心，但要真正實現，仍有許多關鍵技術需要突破。
Starship 隔熱罩成關注焦點
目前討論最多的問題之一，就是保護 Starship 上段在重返大氣層時不被高溫燒毀的數千塊小型六角形隔熱磚。
Starship 的隔熱罩採用的是熱防護系統 (Thermal Protection System, TPS) 技術，其概念源自太空梭。這些隔熱磚由矽質陶瓷材料製成，可承受高達華氏 3,000 度 (約攝氏 1,650 度) 高溫。
任何返回地球的太空飛行器，其隔熱罩都難免受損，因此必須接受檢查。SpaceX 近幾次測試 Starship 的目標之一，就是蒐集隔熱罩數據，以持續改善技術與設計。
7 月稍早，在 Starship 第 13 次試飛中，上段火箭於印度洋濺落時並未爆炸，讓馬斯克相當振奮。測試後發生爆炸其實並不罕見，也不令人意外。由於火箭成功保存下來，SpaceX 得以取得更多隔熱罩數據。
不過，測試結束後，部分 NASA 科學家在 LinkedIn 發文質疑，目前的 TPS 技術是否足以支撐快速重複使用。
Charles Miller、Dan Rasky 及 Charles Camarda 寫道，「根據最近一次 Starship 飛行的數據，我們認為目前的熱防護系統 (TPS) 技術已走入死胡同，無法實現真正的完全且快速重複使用。」
他們指出，目前 TPS 雖然能正常運作，但每次飛行後，隔熱磚仍必須檢查與更換。這代表每艘 Starship 可能需要在維修廠停留數天甚至數周。
乍看之下這似乎不是大問題，但 Starship 的目標，是讓進入太空軌道的成本較目前已相當低成本、且可部分重複使用的 Falcon 9 火箭再降低 90% 以上。而快速重複使用正是 SpaceX 壓低成本的重要關鍵。
如果 Starship 無法按照規劃頻繁重複使用，SpaceX 就必須打造更多 Starship，才能達成每年數千次發射的目標。而建造更多 Starship，也可能拖慢公司發展太空通訊與 AI 相關業務的進度。
這些延誤對股市而言，是一項重大風險。目前 SpaceX 高達 1 兆美元的估值，很大程度建立在 Starship 能帶動公司營收快速成長的預期之上。
當然，SpaceX 本身也十分清楚隔熱罩仍需持續改良。馬斯克過去幾年來已多次在 X 平台談論這項技術。
此外，SpaceX 改善火箭技術的能力在業界幾乎無人能及。投資人或許相信，公司最終仍能成功解決隔熱罩問題，並持續提升隔熱技術。但投資人仍應密切關注熱防護系統的問題。
不過，分析認為，隔熱罩問題可能並非導致 SpaceX 股價下跌的主因。投資人目前更擔心的是公司估值偏高，以及 IPO 禁售期即將到期，早期投資人持股陸續解禁，市場流通股數增加，可能帶來額外賣壓。
paras_en: According to a report by Barron's, SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock price fell to a new low on Friday (7/31), down about 20% from its IPO price six weeks ago. Surprisingly, the stock, which had skyrocketed on its first day of trading, has quickly given up its gains.

SpaceX stock fell 3.4% to $108.37 on Friday, with an intraday low of $107.01. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively, on the same day. As of Friday's opening, SpaceX's stock price had already fallen 17% from its IPO price of $135.

For investors, the stock price is naturally the most pressing concern. However, for CEO Elon Musk, aside from the capital market, he must overcome a series of technical challenges to realize SpaceX's ultimate vision. Musk hopes that SpaceX's Starship, a large, fully reusable rocket, will be launched thousands of times a year.

One of the most discussed issues is the protection of the Starship's upper stage from high temperatures when re-entering the Earth's atmosphere, using thousands of small, hexagonal heat shield tiles. The Starship's heat shield uses Thermal Protection System (TPS) technology, which originated from the space shuttle. These heat shield tiles are made of silicon-based ceramic materials and can withstand temperatures of up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit (approximately 1,650 degrees Celsius).

Any spacecraft returning to Earth will inevitably damage its heat shield, requiring inspection. One of SpaceX's goals in recent Starship tests is to collect heat shield data to continuously improve the technology and design. In early July, during the 13th Starship test flight, the upper stage rocket did not explode when it splashed down in the Indian Ocean, which pleased Musk. Post-test explosions are not uncommon and not unexpected. Since the rocket was successfully preserved, SpaceX was able to obtain more heat shield data.

However, after the test, some NASA scientists questioned on LinkedIn whether the current TPS technology is sufficient to support rapid reuse. Charles Miller, Dan Rasky, and Charles Camarda wrote, 'Based on the recent Starship flight data, we believe that the current TPS technology has reached a dead end and cannot achieve true and rapid reuse.' They pointed out that while the current TPS works, the heat shield tiles still need to be inspected and replaced after each flight, which means each Starship may need to stay in the repair shop for several days or even weeks.

At first glance, this may not seem like a big problem, but Starship's goal is to reduce the cost of entering orbit by more than 90% compared to the already relatively low-cost and partially reusable Falcon 9 rocket. Rapid reuse is a key factor in SpaceX's plan to lower costs. If Starship cannot be reused frequently as planned, SpaceX will need to build more Starships to achieve its goal of thousands of launches per year. Building more Starships may also slow down the company's development of space communications and AI-related businesses.

These delays pose a significant risk to the stock market. SpaceX's valuation of over $1 trillion is largely based on the expectation that Starship will drive rapid revenue growth for the company. Of course, SpaceX is also aware that the heat shield needs to be continuously improved. Musk has discussed this technology on the X platform several times in recent years.

Additionally, SpaceX's ability to improve rocket technology is almost unmatched in the industry. Investors may believe that the company will eventually succeed in solving the heat shield problem and continue to enhance heat shield technology. However, investors should still closely monitor the TPS issue.

Analysts believe that the heat shield problem may not be the main reason for SpaceX's stock price decline. Investors are currently more concerned about the company's high valuation and the upcoming expiration of the IPO lock-up period, which may lead to additional selling pressure as early investors' shares are unlocked and the number of circulating shares increases.

items.title: AI燒錢潮迎來分水嶺！科技六巨頭一周市值波動合計近2兆美元
items.title_en: AI Spending Reaches a Turning Point as Tech Giants' Market Value Fluctuates by Nearly $2 Trillion
paras: 美國大型科技股本週在財報發布後走勢明顯分化，Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 單週累計增加近 1.5 兆美元市值；蘋果 (AAPL-US)、Meta (META-US) 與特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 則遭遇賣壓。投資人開始重新評估各家公司投入人工智慧 (AI) 的回報能力。
《CNBC》報導，截至週五，6 家已公布財報的科技巨頭市值劇烈波動：3 家公司合計增加近 1.5 兆美元，另外 3 家則蒸發約 4,420 億美元，漲跌金額合計接近 2 兆美元。
市場反應顯示，投資人並非全面看好或看壞 AI 支出，而是開始依據雲端成長、變現進度及資本效率，挑選可能率先勝出的企業。
其中，微軟本週市值增加超過 6,000 億美元，亞馬遜與 Google 母公司 Alphabet 也各自增加逾 4,000 億美元。三大雲端服務商均繳出強勁成長，讓市場相信，過去數年投入 AI 基礎設施的龐大資金，正逐漸轉化為實際需求與營收。
相較之下，Meta 財報公布後股價重挫，本週市值蒸發約 850 億美元。投資人仍不確定其 AI 基礎設施何時能形成明確的外部收入來源。
蘋果受到記憶體短缺及財測不如預期拖累，市值減少逾 3,500 億美元；特斯拉因自由現金流轉負並預告支出增加，市值縮水約 70 億美元。
傑富瑞全球科技、媒體與電信投資銀行共同主管 Jason Greenberg 表示，科技巨頭未來 12 個月的 AI 支出正朝近 8,000 億美元邁進。如今市場已不再質疑 AI 是否有人使用，或晶片與運算能力是否存在真實需求，而是詢問真正的問題：「長期獲利能否大到足以支撐如此龐大的投資？」
亞馬遜的財報成為市場信心的重要支撐。
亞馬遜第二季雲端部門 Amazon Web Services (AWS) 營收年增 37%，創 2021 年以來最快成長。由於 AWS 是亞馬遜承接大部分 AI 相關業務的核心平台，其成長速度也被視為衡量 AI 基礎設施需求的重要指標。
亞馬遜同時將 2026 年資本支出預估由 2,000 億美元上調至 2,200 億美元，顯示公司將繼續擴建 AI 基礎設施。儘管支出規模進一步提高，強勁的 AWS 成長仍緩解市場對投資超前需求的疑慮，推動亞馬遜週五股價收盤噴漲逾 15%。
Forrester 分析師 Tracy Woo 指出，AWS 的高速成長顯示，亞馬遜的基礎設施投資正在回應市場需求，而非遠遠跑在需求之前。不過，亞馬遜股價今年表現仍相對落後，年初迄今僅上漲約 4%。
蘋果面臨的情況則截然不同。雖然最新一季營收、獲利及 iPhone 銷售均優於市場預期，但公司預估本季營收將成長 9% 至 11%，低於分析師預期的 12%。蘋果將財測偏弱歸因於供應限制，特別是裝置所需記憶體嚴重短缺，以及晶片製造產能競爭升高。
供應壓力已促使蘋果調高 Mac 與 iPad 售價，分析師也預期 iPhone 今年可能跟進漲價。蘋果週五股價收盤下跌逾 7%，但年初迄今仍上漲約 23%。由於蘋果並未像其他科技巨頭一樣大幅擴張資本支出，先前一度被市場視為避開 AI 軍備競賽的替代性投資標的。
微軟與 Meta 的股價反差，也進一步突顯市場評價標準正在改變。微軟週四大漲 15%，Meta 則下跌 8%。兩家公司都持續擴大 AI 投資，但微軟已透過 Azure 雲端服務展現需求與變現能力，Meta 目前的 AI 基礎設施則主要服務內部業務，對外商業模式仍不夠清楚。
Gabelli 投資組合經理 Hendi Susanto 表示，投資人對 Meta 的耐心正在下降。雖然執行長祖克柏曾表示，公司正考慮讓 AI 基礎設施產生更多外部收入，但財報電話會議未提供明確進展，因而加深市場疑慮。
總言之，本輪財報季反映，華爾街對 AI 的關注焦點已從「是否值得投資」，轉向「誰能最快把投資變成獲利」。雲端業務高速成長的微軟、亞馬遜與 Alphabet 獲得資金追捧；Meta 與蘋果則因變現能見度及供應限制承受壓力，科技巨頭之間的估值差距也隨之擴大。
paras_en: The US tech giants' stock prices have shown a clear divergence after their earnings reports were released, with Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), and Microsoft (MSFT-US) seeing their market value increase by nearly $1.5 trillion in a single week, while Apple (AAPL-US), Meta (META-US), and Tesla (TSLA-US) faced selling pressure. Investors have started to reevaluate the returns on investment in artificial intelligence (AI) for each company.

According to CNBC, as of Friday, the market value of the six tech giants that have released their earnings reports has fluctuated sharply, with three companies seeing their market value increase by nearly $1.5 trillion and the other three losing around $442 billion, resulting in a total fluctuation of nearly $2 trillion.

The market reaction shows that investors are not uniformly optimistic or pessimistic about AI spending, but are instead selecting companies that may emerge victorious based on cloud growth, monetization progress, and capital efficiency.

Microsoft's market value increased by over $600 billion this week, while Amazon and Google's parent company Alphabet each increased by more than $400 billion. The three cloud service providers have all delivered strong growth, making the market believe that the massive investment in AI infrastructure over the past few years is gradually being converted into real demand and revenue.

In contrast, Meta's stock price plummeted after its earnings report was released, with its market value evaporating by around $85 billion this week. Investors are still uncertain when Meta's AI infrastructure will generate clear external revenue sources.

Apple's market value decreased by more than $350 billion due to memory shortages and lower-than-expected earnings forecasts, while Tesla's market value shrank by around $7 billion due to a decline in free cash flow and increased spending.

Jason Greenberg, co-head of global technology, media, and telecommunications investment banking at Jefferies, stated that the tech giants' AI spending over the next 12 months is expected to approach $800 billion. The market is no longer questioning whether AI is being used or whether there is real demand for chips and computing power, but is instead asking the real question: 'Will long-term profits be large enough to support such massive investment?'

Amazon's earnings report has become a key support for market confidence. Amazon Web Services (AWS) revenue grew 37% year-over-year in the second quarter, the fastest growth since 2021. As AWS is the core platform for Amazon's AI-related businesses, its growth rate is also seen as an important indicator of the demand for AI infrastructure.

Amazon also raised its 2026 capital expenditure estimate from $200 billion to $220 billion, indicating that the company will continue to expand its AI infrastructure. Despite the increased spending, the strong growth of AWS has alleviated market concerns about investment demand, driving Amazon's stock price up by over 15% on Friday.

Forrester analyst Tracy Woo pointed out that AWS's high growth shows that Amazon's infrastructure investment is responding to market demand, rather than running ahead of it. However, Amazon's stock price has still underperformed this year, with a gain of only around 4% since the beginning of the year.

Apple, on the other hand, faces a different situation. Although its latest quarterly revenue, profit, and iPhone sales all exceeded market expectations, the company's revenue forecast for the current quarter is expected to grow 9-11%, lower than analysts' expectations of 12%. Apple attributed the weak forecast to supply constraints, particularly the severe shortage of memory required for devices, as well as increased competition for chip manufacturing capacity.

The supply pressure has led Apple to raise the prices of Macs and iPads, and analysts expect iPhone prices to follow suit this year. Apple's stock price fell by over 7% on Friday, but is still up around 23% since the beginning of the year. As Apple has not expanded its capital expenditure significantly like other tech giants, it was once seen as an alternative investment target for avoiding the AI arms race.

The contrast between Microsoft's and Meta's stock prices further highlights the changing market evaluation standards. Microsoft surged 15% on Thursday, while Meta fell 8%. Both companies are continuing to expand their AI investments, but Microsoft has demonstrated demand and monetization capabilities through its Azure cloud service, while Meta's current AI infrastructure primarily serves internal businesses, with an unclear external commercial model.

Gabelli investment portfolio manager Hendi Susanto stated that investors' patience with Meta is wearing thin. Although CEO Zuckerberg has said that the company is considering generating more external revenue from its AI infrastructure, the earnings call did not provide clear progress, deepening market concerns.

In summary, this earnings season reflects that Wall Street's focus on AI has shifted from 'whether it's worth investing' to 'who can turn investments into profits the fastest.' Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet, which have high-growth cloud businesses, have received funding support, while Meta and Apple face pressure due to limited visibility on monetization and supply constraints, resulting in a widening valuation gap between the tech giants.

items.title: SpaceX首份財報倒數 大摩維持300美元目標價：最危險時刻來臨 AI價值仍遭低估
items.title_en: SpaceX's First Quarterly Report Looms: Morgan Stanley Keeps $300 Target, Warns of Most Dangerous Moment; AI Value Still Underestimated
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US)將於 8 月 4 日公布首次公開募股 (IPO) 後首份季度財報，在股價自歷史高點大幅回落、且大規模限售股即將解禁之際，市場高度關注公司能否透過財報與管理層展望重振投資人信心。摩根士丹利指出，這次財報可能是 SpaceX 上市以來面臨的「最危險時刻」，真正左右市場情緒的未必是財務數字，而是管理層對 AI、星鏈 (Starlink) 及星艦 (Starship) 未來發展的最新說法。
SpaceX 於 6 月 12 日以每股 135 美元掛牌上市，股價一度衝上 225 美元，市值最高突破 3 兆美元，超越亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與微軟(MSFT-US)。然而，在市場重新評估估值及 AI 題材後，股價已回落至約 112 美元，較高點下跌約五成，使這份財報更受到市場矚目。
除了財報本身外，市場另一焦點是 8 月 6 日即將到來的限售股解禁。屆時約 9.115 億股股票將符合解禁條件，以目前市值估算約相當於 1,000 億美元股票可能流入市場，意味著 SpaceX 恐面臨龐大賣壓，也可能放大財報發布前後的股價波動。
摩根士丹利預估，SpaceX 第二季營收約 67.5 億美元，調整後每股虧損 0.35 美元。該行預估，第二季 Starlink 全球消費者用戶數將達 1,200 萬戶，每位用戶平均每月收入 (ARPU) 約 65.5 美元。
不過，摩根士丹利認為，市場真正關注的是管理層對未來業務的評論，而非短期財務數據。該行預期，SpaceX 法說會風格將類似特斯拉 (TSLA-US)，不會提供過多量化財測，而是聚焦星艦開發時程、AI 算力部署速度，以及 Grok 與 Cursor 模型的整體發展方向。
分析師表示，投資人尤其希望了解 Starlink 企業客戶拓展進度、公司是否釋出 2027 年前 AI 運算能力突破 2GW 的擴產藍圖，以及 SpaceX AI 與 Cursor 共同開發 AI 模型的最新進展。
摩根士丹利指出，由於 Cursor 收購案預計本季稍晚才會完成，因此第二季財報預料不會揭露該交易的具體財務貢獻，但市場仍期待管理層說明整體 AI 布局策略。
儘管近期股價大幅修正，摩根士丹利仍維持 SpaceX 目標價 300 美元，認為目前市場仍低估其 AI 業務價值。
該行估算，SpaceX 估值中，太空業務價值約每股 8 美元，網路與 Starlink 業務約 128 美元，X 平台及 Grok AI 約 12 美元，企業 AI 業務則高達 152 美元，占整體估值比重超過一半，顯示 AI 仍是未來主要成長動能。
除了財報之外，市場另一項潛在利多來自預計 8 月底至 9 月初執行的 Starship Flight 14 飛行任務。若此次任務成功完成上級艙回收，將代表 Starship 在完全可重複使用火箭技術上取得重大突破，進一步提升市場對 SpaceX 長期商業模式的信心。
不過，在短期內，市場情緒仍偏向保守。摩根士丹利透露，近期舉辦的投資人會議中，超過三分之二的與會投資人看空 SpaceX 年底前股價表現，主要擔憂財報缺乏足夠催化劑，加上解禁股票帶來龐大供給，將持續壓抑股價。
報告指出，即將解禁的早期投資人多數已累積數十倍投資報酬，即使目前股價較高點回落，仍具有強烈獲利了結誘因。因此，在財報與解禁雙重因素交織下，SpaceX 短線股價波動性恐明顯升高，市場將密切關注管理層是否能透過 AI、Starlink 及 Starship 發展藍圖，重新凝聚投資人對公司長期成長的信心。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) will release its first quarterly report after its IPO on August 4, as its share price has fallen sharply from historic highs and a large block of restricted shares is about to unlock. The market is closely watching whether the earnings release and management outlook can revive investor confidence. Morgan Stanley says this report could be the "most dangerous moment" SpaceX has faced since going public, and that what will truly sway sentiment may not be the numbers themselves but management's latest comments on AI, Starlink and Starship development.

SpaceX listed on June 12 at $135 per share, briefly soaring to $225 and pushing its market cap past $3 trillion, surpassing Amazon (AMZN-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US). After the market re‑evaluated the valuation and AI narrative, the price has slipped to around $112, roughly a 50% drop from the peak, making this earnings release even more closely watched.

Beyond the earnings, another market focus is the upcoming unlock of restricted shares on August 6. About 911.5 million shares will become eligible for sale, which at current market values represents roughly $100 billion of stock that could flow into the market, potentially creating massive selling pressure and amplifying price swings around the earnings announcement.

Morgan Stanley estimates SpaceX’s Q2 revenue at about $6.75 billion, with an adjusted loss of $0.35 per share. The firm projects Starlink’s global consumer subscriber base to reach 12 million in Q2, with an average revenue per user (ARPU) of about $65.5 per month.

However, Morgan Stanley believes the market is really interested in management’s commentary on future business, not short‑term financial metrics. The firm expects SpaceX’s earnings call to resemble Tesla’s (TSLA-US) style—providing limited quantitative guidance and focusing on Starship development timelines, AI compute deployment speed, and the overall direction of the Grok and Cursor models.

Analysts say investors especially want to hear about Starlink’s enterprise customer expansion, whether the company will unveil a roadmap to exceed 2 GW of AI compute capacity before 2027, and the latest progress on AI models jointly developed by SpaceX AI and Cursor.

Morgan Stanley notes that because the Cursor acquisition is expected to close later this quarter, the Q2 results likely won’t disclose the transaction’s specific financial contribution, but the market still expects management to outline the broader AI strategy.
Despite the recent sharp price correction, Morgan Stanley maintains a $300 price target for SpaceX, arguing the market still undervalues its AI business potential.

The firm breaks down SpaceX’s valuation: roughly $8 per share for the space business, about $128 for the network and Starlink business, $12 for the X platform and Grok AI, and as much as $152 for the enterprise AI segment—over half of the total valuation—showing AI remains the primary growth engine.

In addition to the earnings, a potential catalyst could come from the planned Starship Flight 14 mission slated for late August to early September. If the mission successfully recovers the upper stage, it would mark a major breakthrough in fully reusable rocket technology and boost confidence in SpaceX’s long‑term commercial model.

In the short term, market sentiment remains cautious. Morgan Stanley disclosed that in a recent investor meeting, more than two‑thirds of participants were bearish on SpaceX’s stock performance through year‑end, citing concerns that the earnings report lacks sufficient catalysts and that the large share unlock will keep supply pressure high, suppressing the price.

The report notes that many early investors whose shares are about to unlock have already realized multiples of their original investment, so even with the price now below its peak they have strong incentives to take profits. Consequently, the combination of earnings and the share unlock is likely to increase short‑term volatility, and the market will watch closely whether management can rally investor confidence in the company’s long‑term growth through AI, Starlink and Starship development plans.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉亞馬遜飆超15% 蘋果挫逾7% 那指收高但創2006年來最慘7月表現
items.title_en: US Stocks Rise as Investors Focus on Tech Earnings, Nasdaq Sees Worst July Performance Since 2006
paras: 美股週五 (31 日) 集體收高，投資人暫時淡化美債殖利率攀升帶來的壓力，轉而聚焦大型科技公司財報。亞馬遜營收優於預期，激勵股價狂飆逾 15%，帶動那斯達克指數上漲 1%，標普 500 指數同步攀漲。
儘管美股盤勢大幅震盪，三大指數全週仍同步上揚。道瓊與標普 500 指數均週漲約 1%，那斯達克指數則攀升約 1.6%，而 Google 母公司 Alphabet、亞馬遜與微軟本週市值合計增加近 1.5 兆美元。
綜觀 7 月份，道瓊月漲 0.3%，連續第四個月收紅；標普 500 指數月線收黑 0.1%，那斯達克指數則下跌 3.2%，創下 2006 年以來最糟糕的 7 月表現。
美債殖利率居高不下，仍是籠罩市場的主要風險。30 年期美債殖利率本週升至 2007 年以來最高，週五再漲約 4 個基點至 5.25%；10 年期美債殖利率盤中突破 4.7%，創 2025 年 1 月以來新高。
債市波動反映投資人對聯準會主席華許抗通膨決心的疑慮。華許本週雖重申將致力壓低通膨，卻也坦言聯準會「沒有魔法棒」，未能平息市場的不安。
此外，值得關注的是，《紐約時報》週五報導，華許本週提出構想，考慮減少聯準會利率會議次數。
能源市場方面，西德州原油期貨週五升幅約 1.3%，收在每桶 84.67 美元；布蘭特原油期貨上漲 1.2%，收在每桶 90.12 美元。
美國總統川普表示，美方將恢復對伊朗的大規模軍事打擊，以迫使伊朗政權重返談判桌，並矢言對伊朗發動「非常猛烈」的攻擊。
美股週五 (31 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭普遍收高。Meta (META-US) 上漲 3.28%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 重挫 7.35%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 大漲 6.73%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 3.02%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 狂飆 15.32%。
費城半導體族群漲跌互見。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 1.90%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.37%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.93%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 1.18%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 2.63%；美光 (MU-US) 重挫 5.90%。
台股 ADR 多揚升。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 0.23%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 1.15%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 0.48%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.16%。
企業新聞
亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 週五瘋漲 15.32% 至每股 271.58 美元，創 2012 年以來最大單日漲幅，本週升幅超 15%，在雲端運算業務強勁成長的帶動下，亞馬遜第二季營收優於市場預期，強化投資人對 AI 支出轉化為實際營收的信心。
蘋果 2026 會計年度第三季 (截至 6 月底) 營收雖優於預期，iPhone 銷售額也成長 22%，但服務業務營收未達市場預估。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週五股價狂瀉 7.35%，收在每股 308.91 美元，創 2025 年 4 月以來最差單日表現，也讓輝達重新奪回全球市值最高企業寶座。
SK 海力士週五在南韓觸及漲停，飆升近 30%，三星電子同步大漲 27%，共同推動 KOSPI 指數勁揚近 18%；但 SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 卻逆勢收跌 3.6%。
受惠於第二季營收與獲利雙雙優於預期，雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 週五收紅 2.35%。雪佛龍當季淨利達 121 億美元，較去年同期成長近 400%。
埃克森美孚 (XOM-US) 第二季獲利不及市場預期，股價下跌 0.97%。公司調整後每股盈餘為 3.52 美元，低於 LSEG 調查分析師預估的 3.60 美元。
加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase (COIN-US) 連續第三季陷入虧損，當季淨損達 3.595 億美元，每股虧損 1.36 美元，表現遠遜於市場預期，拖累股價重挫 10.59%，收在每股 146.26 美元。
Reddit (RDDT-US) 第二季營收與獲利雙雙優於預期，財測也遠超市場預估，但執行長 Steve Huffman 坦言，來自 Google 搜尋導流不如過去穩定，引發投資人對平台流量成長的疑慮，拖累股價暴跌 20.99%，收在每股 140.67 美元。
華爾街分析
盈透證券高級經濟學家 José Torres 指出，美股主指歷經劇烈震盪後，美股仍在波動中收高。過去兩天公布的科技巨頭財報顯示，AI 龐大資本支出需求依然強勁，加上雲端運算與半導體銷售表現亮眼，進一步提振投資人對後市的信心。
Carson 集團市場策略師 Ryan Detrick 認為，近期行情較像是漲勢暫歇，市場正為下一波上攻累積動能；在經歷 4 月與 5 月連續上漲後，出現適度回檔也屬合理。
然而，美國合眾銀行資產管理公司首席股票策略師 Terry Sandven 警告，若 10 年期美債殖利率進一步逼近 5%，可能打擊市場情緒，並對股票估值帶來更大壓力。
Sandven 形容，目前市場如同「充滿焦慮與機會的雲霄飛車」。企業財報依舊強勁，通膨相對穩定，但持續升溫的中東衝突正推高油價，也可能重新加劇通膨壓力。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)
paras_en: US stocks closed higher on Friday, as investors temporarily overlooked the pressure from rising US bond yields and focused on the earnings of major tech companies. Amazon's revenue exceeded expectations, boosting its stock price by over 15% and driving the Nasdaq index up 1%, while the S&P 500 index also rose.

Despite the significant fluctuations in the US stock market, all three major indices rose for the week. The Dow and S&P 500 indices both rose about 1% for the week, while the Nasdaq index climbed approximately 1.6%. The combined market value of Google's parent company Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft increased by nearly $1.5 trillion for the week.

For the month of July, the Dow rose 0.3%, marking its fourth consecutive month of gains, while the S&P 500 index fell 0.1% and the Nasdaq index plummeted 3.2%, posting its worst July performance since 2006.

The high US bond yields remain a major risk looming over the market. The 30-year US bond yield rose to its highest level since 2007, increasing by about 4 basis points to 5.25% on Friday, while the 10-year US bond yield broke through 4.7% to reach a new high since January 2025.

The fluctuations in the bond market reflect investors' doubts about Federal Reserve Chairman Powell's determination to combat inflation. Although Powell reiterated his commitment to lowering inflation, he also acknowledged that the Fed has no 'magic wand,' which failed to alleviate market concerns.
Additionally, it is worth noting that The New York Times reported on Friday that Powell proposed an idea to reduce the number of Fed interest rate meetings.
In the energy market, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil futures rose about 1.3% to $84.67 per barrel, while Brent crude oil futures climbed 1.2% to $90.12 per barrel.

US President Trump stated that the US would resume large-scale military strikes against Iran to force the Iranian government back to the negotiating table, vowing to launch a 'very violent' attack on Iran.

The main US stock indices performed as follows on Friday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 276.97 points, or 0.53%, to 52,485.03; the Nasdaq index rose 251.68 points, or 1.00%, to 25,373.85; the S&P 500 index rose 52.09 points, or 0.70%, to 7,489.72; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 8.09 points, or 0.07%, to 11,311.08; and the NYSE FANG+ Index rose 288.30 points, or 1.70%, to 17,261.36.

Among the NYSE FANG+ Index, the tech giants generally rose. Meta (META-US) rose 3.28%, while Apple (AAPL-US) plummeted 7.35%. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) surged 6.73%, Microsoft (MSFT-US) rose 3.02%, and Amazon (AMZN-US) skyrocketed 15.32%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index saw mixed results, with AMD (AMD-US) falling 1.90%, Broadcom (AVGO-US) rising 0.37%, Nvidia (NVDA-US) rising 2.93%, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) rising 1.18%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) falling 2.63%, and Micron (MU-US) plummeting 5.90%.
Taiwanese ADRs generally rose, with TSMC ADR (TSM-US) rising 0.23%, ASE ADR (ASX-US) rising 1.15%, UMC ADR (UMC-US) rising 0.48%, and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT-US) falling 0.16%.

Amazon (AMZN-US) skyrocketed 15.32% to $271.58 per share on Friday, posting its largest single-day gain since 2012, with a weekly rise of over 15%. The strong growth in its cloud computing business drove Amazon's second-quarter revenue to exceed market expectations, bolstering investors' confidence in the company's ability to turn AI spending into actual revenue.

Apple's fiscal Q3 revenue (ending June) exceeded expectations, with iPhone sales growing 22%, but its services revenue failed to meet market estimates. Apple's stock price plummeted 7.35% to $308.91 per share on Friday, posting its worst single-day performance since April 2025, and allowing Nvidia to regain its position as the world's most valuable company.

SK Hynix rose to its daily limit in South Korea, surging nearly 30%, while Samsung Electronics also rose sharply by 27%, jointly driving the KOSPI index up nearly 18%. However, SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell 3.6%.

Chevron (CVX-US) rose 2.35% on Friday, driven by its second-quarter revenue and earnings exceeding expectations. The company's net income reached $12.1 billion, growing nearly 400% from the same period last year.

ExxonMobil's (XOM-US) second-quarter earnings failed to meet market expectations, causing its stock price to fall 0.97%. The company's adjusted earnings per share were $3.52, lower than the $3.60 estimated by analysts surveyed by LSEG.

Coinbase (COIN-US) reported a net loss of $359.5 million for the third consecutive quarter, with a loss per share of $1.36, far below market expectations, leading to a 10.59% decline in its stock price to $146.26 per share.

Reddit (RDDT-US) reported second-quarter revenue and earnings that exceeded expectations, with its forecast also surpassing market estimates. However, CEO Steve Huffman expressed concerns about the instability of traffic from Google searches, leading to a 20.99% plunge in its stock price to $140.67 per share.

According to José Torres, a senior economist at Evercore ISI, the US stock market has risen after experiencing significant fluctuations. The recent earnings reports from tech giants have shown that demand for large-scale AI capital expenditures remains strong, and the impressive performance of cloud computing and semiconductor sales has further boosted investor confidence in the market.

Ryan Detrick, a market strategist at Carson Group, believes that the recent market trend is more like a temporary pause in the upward trend, and the market is accumulating energy for the next wave of gains. After experiencing consecutive gains in April and May, a moderate correction is reasonable.

However, Terry Sandven, chief equity strategist at US Bank Wealth Management, warned that if the 10-year US bond yield approaches 5%, it may hurt market sentiment and put more pressure on stock valuations.

Sandven described the current market as a 'rollercoaster full of anxiety and opportunities.' While corporate earnings remain strong and inflation is relatively stable, the escalating conflict in the Middle East is driving up oil prices and may rekindle inflationary pressures.

items.title: 輝達重新超越蘋果 奪回全球市值王寶座
items.title_en: Nvidia Reclaims Global Market-Cap Crown, Surpassing Apple Again
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 週五 (31 日) 股價收漲 2.9% 至每股 200.75 美元，推升市值至 4.86 兆美元；在蘋果財報公布後股價重挫之際，輝達市值重新超車蘋果，奪回全球市值冠軍寶座。
蘋果先前一度登上全球市值冠軍，但週四公布財報後遭遇賣壓，週五盤中跌幅一度達 10%，尾盤收斂部分跌幅，市值降至約 4.51 兆美元。
另一方面，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 的財報與資本支出計畫，再度凸顯輝達晶片在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮中的重要地位。
亞馬遜將全年資本支出預測由 2,000 億美元上調至 2,200 億美元，同時淡化自研 AI 晶片與輝達之間的競爭關係。
亞馬遜執行長賈西 (Andrew R. Jassy) 在財報電話會議上表示，公司與輝達維持深度合作，並將繼續把旗下雲端運算平台 AWS 打造成運行輝達晶片的最佳環境。他指出，在可預見的未來，仍有大量客戶會持續採用輝達處理器。
不過，亞馬遜自研晶片帶來的潛在威脅並未消失。市場近期傳出，亞馬遜可能把原本主要供 AWS 內部使用的 Trainium AI 晶片直接銷售給客戶，進一步擴大與輝達的競爭範圍。
賈西證實，越來越多客戶有意在 AWS 雲端服務之外，單獨取得亞馬遜的 AI 訓練技術與晶片。公司正與相關客戶展開討論並評估可行性，他認為未來確實有機會推動這項業務。
儘管大型雲端業者持續發展自研 AI 晶片，輝達目前仍穩居產業龍頭，並重新成為全球市值最高的上市公司。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Nvidia (NVDA-US) closed Friday (the 31st) up 2.9% at $200.75 per share, lifting its market value to $4.86 trillion; as Apple’s stock slumped after its earnings release, Nvidia’s market cap overtook Apple’s, reclaiming the title of world’s most valuable company.

Apple had previously held the global market-cap crown, but after its earnings report on Thursday it faced selling pressure, with the stock falling as much as 10% during Friday’s session before narrowing the loss at the close, leaving its market value around $4.51 trillion.
Meanwhile, Amazon’s (AMZN-US) earnings and capital‑expenditure plans again highlighted the importance of Nvidia chips in the AI boom.
Amazon raised its full‑year capital‑expenditure forecast from $200 billion to $220 billion and downplayed any competitive rivalry between its own AI chips and Nvidia’s.

Amazon CEO Andrew R. Jassy said during the earnings call that the company maintains deep cooperation with Nvidia and will continue to make its cloud platform AWS the best environment for running Nvidia chips. He noted that, for the foreseeable future, a large number of customers will keep using Nvidia processors.

However, the potential threat from Amazon’s in‑house chips has not vanished. Recent market chatter suggests Amazon may start selling its Trainium AI chip—originally intended mainly for internal AWS use—directly to customers, further expanding competition with Nvidia.

Jassy confirmed that more and more customers are interested in obtaining Amazon’s AI training technology and chips outside of AWS cloud services. The company is discussing feasibility with those customers and believes there is indeed an opportunity to launch such a business in the future.
Despite large cloud providers continuing to develop their own AI chips, Nvidia remains the industry leader and has once again become the world’s most valuable publicly traded company.

items.title: 伊朗戰爭擾亂供應鏈 美兩大油商估柴油價格續漲至下半年
items.title_en: Iran War Disrupts Supply Chain, US Oil Majors Expect Diesel Price to Rise in 2H
paras: 艾克森美孚 (XOM-US) 與雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 在公布第二季財報後同步警告，隨著伊朗戰事持續衝擊全球能源供應，加上中國成品油出口減少、俄羅斯煉油廠停工及維修因素，全球柴油等成品油市場供應恐持續吃緊，下半年燃料價格預料將維持高檔，煉油業者也可望延續高獲利。
兩家公司第二季煉油業務獲利均大幅成長，主要受惠於全球燃料庫存持續下降，以及成品油供應受限推升煉油利差。
雪佛龍執行長 Mike Wirth 在法說會表示，柴油、取暖油等中間餾分油需求長期仍將保持穩健，因此產品價格第三季甚至更長時間都可能面臨上行壓力。
他表示：「我們預期產品價格將持續面臨上漲壓力，至少延續至第三季，甚至可能更久。包括柴油與取暖油在內的中間餾分油需求，長期來看不太可能明顯下滑。」
能源市場供應緊俏之際，美國汽油零售價格上週再度突破每加侖 4 美元，不僅增加消費者負擔，也為川普政府及共和黨帶來政治壓力。隨著 11 月美國期中選舉逼近，高油價可能成為影響選情的重要經濟議題。
為增加市場供應，美國兩大石油公司均表示，目前正維持高產能運作。
艾克森美孚指出，公司旗下美國煉油廠第二季維持高開工率，柴油產量創下歷史新高；雪佛龍則表示，美國煉油系統平均每日加工量首次突破 100 萬桶，同樣創下歷史紀錄。
不過，艾克森美孚董事長兼執行長 Darren Woods 表示，目前全球煉油廠維持高負載運轉的情況無法長期持續，若要真正改善供應，仍須恢復霍姆茲海峽的正常航運。
Woods 接受 CNBC 訪問時表示：「目前的高產能利用率無法長期維持，因此我認為全球煉油供應緊張的情況還會持續一段時間。」
他指出，艾克森美孚擁有中國以外全球最大的煉油布局，但原油供應中斷仍增加下游煉油業務營運難度。若霍姆茲海峽航運無法恢復正常，全球原油供應仍將持續受限。
兩家公司也提醒，煉油設備仍需例行歲修。雪佛龍預估，第三季歲修停工將使下游業務獲利減少 1.75 億至 2.25 億美元；艾克森美孚則表示，第三季歲修規模將較第二季減少，有助降低對獲利的影響。
財報方面，艾克森美孚第二季調整後下游業務獲利達 41 億美元，較去年同期明顯成長。不過，RBC Capital Markets 分析師 Biraj Borkhataria 指出，考量艾克森美孚擁有全球龐大的煉油產能，部分投資人原本預期公司可繳出更亮眼的煉油業績。
整體獲利表現方面，艾克森美孚第二季每股獲利略低於市場一致預期；雪佛龍則優於華爾街預估。財報公布後，艾克森美孚股價一度下跌約 1%，雪佛龍則上漲約 2%。
市場分析指出，目前全球柴油市場仍同時受到伊朗戰事、中國出口政策、俄羅斯煉油產能受損及庫存偏低等多重因素影響，即使國際原油供應未進一步惡化，成品油市場仍可能維持供不應求，使煉油利差與燃料價格在今年下半年持續受到支撐。
paras_en: ExxonMobil (XOM-US) and Chevron (CVX-US) warned after releasing their Q2 earnings that the ongoing Iran conflict, combined with reduced Chinese refined product exports, Russian refinery outages, and maintenance, may lead to a continued tight supply of diesel and other refined products, with fuel prices expected to remain high in the second half of the year, benefiting refiners.

Both companies saw significant growth in their refining business in Q2, mainly due to declining global fuel inventories and refining margins boosted by limited product supply. Chevron CEO Mike Wirth stated during the earnings call that demand for diesel and other middle distillates is expected to remain robust, putting upward pressure on product prices in Q3 and possibly beyond.

Wirth said, 'We expect product prices to continue facing upward pressure, at least through Q3, and possibly longer. Demand for middle distillates, including diesel and heating oil, is unlikely to decline significantly in the long term.' The US retail gasoline price broke above $4 per gallon again last week, increasing consumer burdens and putting political pressure on the Trump administration and Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections.

To increase market supply, both US oil majors said they are currently operating at high production levels. ExxonMobil noted that its US refineries maintained high utilization rates in Q2, with diesel production reaching a record high, while Chevron said its US refining system processed over 1 million barrels per day for the first time, also a record.

However, ExxonMobil Chairman and CEO Darren Woods stated that the current high utilization rate of global refineries is unsustainable and that a recovery in normal shipping traffic in the Hormuz Strait is needed to truly improve supply. Woods said in a CNBC interview, 'The current high utilization rate is not sustainable, so I think the tight refining supply situation will persist for some time.'

Woods pointed out that ExxonMobil has the largest refining footprint outside of China, but disruptions to crude supply have increased the difficulty of operating its downstream refining business. If shipping in the Hormuz Strait does not return to normal, global crude supply will remain constrained. Both companies also reminded that refineries require regular maintenance, with Chevron estimating that Q3 maintenance will reduce downstream earnings by $175-225 million, while ExxonMobil said its Q3 maintenance will be lower than in Q2, mitigating the impact on earnings.

In terms of earnings, ExxonMobil's Q2 downstream earnings were $4.1 billion, significantly higher than the same period last year. However, RBC Capital Markets analyst Biraj Borkhataria noted that some investors had expected more impressive refining results from ExxonMobil given its large global refining capacity. ExxonMobil's overall Q2 earnings per share were slightly below market expectations, while Chevron's exceeded Wall Street estimates. Following the earnings release, ExxonMobil's stock price fell about 1%, while Chevron's rose about 2%.

Market analysis suggests that the global diesel market is currently influenced by multiple factors, including the Iran conflict, Chinese export policies, Russian refining capacity losses, and low inventories, making it likely that the refined product market will remain tight, supporting refining margins and fuel prices in the second half of the year, even if global crude supply does not deteriorate further.

items.title: 美光前日暴飆18%後拉回！周五重挫5.9% 升息隱憂與獲利賣壓出籠
items.title_en: Micron's 18% Surge the Day Before Pulls Back! Friday Slides 5.9% Amid Rate‑Hike Concerns and Profit‑Taking Pressure
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 股價周五 (31 日) 回落，雖然蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 財報再度證實人工智慧 (AI) 使記憶體需求持續強勁，但市場對利率可能走高的擔憂，削弱投資人樂觀情緒。
美光股價周四股價大漲 18%，周五一度開高上漲，但後來翻黑，終場下跌 5.9%，報每股 823.03 美元。
三名反對聯準會 (Fed) 維持利率不變的官員，進一步說明支持升息的理由，這讓市場擔心，若利率進一步攀升，將抑制企業與消費者支出，進而衝擊美光產品需求。
美光周五也面臨前日大漲後的獲利了結賣壓，尤其近來市場質疑記憶體景氣榮景是否能延續，導致股價波動加劇。
不過，蘋果執行長庫克 (Tim Cook) 在周四盤後的法說會上，消除了市場一部分疑慮。他說：「我們預期 9 月為止一季的記憶體成本還會進一步上揚。」
《華爾街日報》(WSJ) 上周報導，蘋果正遊說川普政府，希望允許其在美國以外市場銷售的裝置使用中國製記憶體晶片。
不過，庫克周四僅保守提及未來可能增加其他記憶體供應商，並未表示蘋果計劃採購中國製記憶體晶片，用於中國市場銷售的產品。這代表市場擔心中國記憶體晶片大量投入市場衝擊美光一事，目前看來仍屬較長期風險。
在此同時，AI 基礎建設支出持續增加，也為記憶體需求提供支撐：亞馬遜周四將資本支出預估 由 2000 億美元上修至 2200 億美元，理由之一正是記憶體晶片成本上升。
華爾街目前仍預期，在 AI 投資持續推升需求下，美光未來至少三年獲利將持續成長。根據 FactSet 資料，美光目前預估本益比不到 6 倍。
paras_en: Micron (MU‑US) stock fell on Friday (the 31st). Although Apple (AAPL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) earnings once again confirmed that artificial intelligence (AI) is keeping memory demand robust, worries that interest rates may rise have dampened investors' optimism.
Micron’s share price jumped 18% on Thursday and opened higher on Friday, but later turned negative and closed down 5.9% at $823.03 per share.

Three Federal Reserve officials who opposed keeping rates unchanged elaborated on reasons to raise rates, prompting market concerns that further rate hikes could curb corporate and consumer spending and hit demand for Micron’s products.

Micron also faced profit‑taking pressure on Friday after the prior day’s surge, especially as the market questions whether the memory‑industry boom can be sustained, leading to heightened stock volatility.
However, Apple CEO Tim Cook, in Thursday’s after‑hours earnings call, allayed part of the market’s worries. He said, “We expect memory costs to continue rising through the September quarter.”
The Wall Street Journal reported last week that Apple is lobbying the Trump administration to allow devices sold outside the United States to use China‑made memory chips.

Cook only conservatively mentioned the possibility of adding other memory suppliers and did not say Apple plans to procure China‑made memory chips for products sold in the Chinese market. This indicates that market fears about a large influx of Chinese memory chips hurting Micron remain a longer‑term risk.

Meanwhile, AI infrastructure spending keeps climbing, supporting memory demand: Amazon on Thursday raised its capital‑expenditure outlook from $200 billion to $220 billion, partly due to rising memory‑chip costs.

Wall Street still expects that, with AI investment continuously boosting demand, Micron’s earnings will keep growing for at least the next three years. According to FactSet data, Micron’s current price‑to‑earnings ratio is under 6×.

items.title: 蘋果正評估中國記憶體供應商 盼緩解供貨與成本壓力
items.title_en: Apple Evaluates Chinese Memory Suppliers to Alleviate Supply and Cost Pressures
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 在最新財報電話會議中表示，隨著記憶體價格持續上漲，公司正評估不同供應來源，包括中國業者，希望藉此增加供應彈性。儘管相關計畫引起美國國會議員反對，蘋果現階段仍未排除任何選項。
蘋果指出，該公司今年第一季（截至 3 月底）的記憶體採購成本高於去年第四季（截至去年 12 月底），第二季（截至 6 月底）的成本又明顯上升。雖然庫存效益抵銷部分影響，但公司預估，第三季（截至 9 月底）的記憶體成本還將進一步增加。
在被問及是否可能向中國長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 採購 DRAM，以及向長江存儲 (YMTC) 採購 NAND 快閃記憶體時，蘋果表示，公司仍在檢視各種供應來源。引進更多供應商可望改善供貨情況，至於能否降低採購價格，目前仍不確定。
近期報導指出，蘋果據傳正在測試長鑫存儲的 DRAM 產品，顯示這家中國記憶體製造商未來可能進入蘋果供應鏈。不過，相關合作仍處於評估階段，蘋果尚未正式宣布採購決定。
《金融時報》先前引述消息人士報導，蘋果曾向川普政府爭取批准採購長鑫存儲的 DRAM。長鑫存儲因被美國國防部認定與中國人民解放軍存在關聯，目前仍被列入相關黑名單。
《彭博》記者 Mark Gurman 近期也透露，蘋果正與川普政府溝通，希望一旦決定採購長鑫存儲或長江存儲的記憶體，能降低在華府面臨的政治反彈。
根據目前傳出的規畫，蘋果若最終向中國業者採購記憶體，相關零組件將僅用於在中國市場銷售的產品。儘管如此，這項安排仍未能消除美國國會的國安疑慮。
一群美國國會議員已要求蘋果放棄採購中國記憶體的計畫，並要求公司在 8 月 21 日前承諾不會推動相關方案。議員同時要求蘋果完整揭露，是否曾向長鑫存儲或長江存儲提供技術資訊，以及相關資訊的具體內容。
從蘋果在財報電話會議中的說法來看，公司目前仍以確保供應穩定為主要考量，尚未因國會壓力排除中國供應商。不過，蘋果最終是否落實採購，仍有待公司進一步公布。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) stated in its latest earnings call that it is assessing different supply sources, including Chinese companies, to increase supply flexibility as memory prices continue to rise. Despite opposition from US lawmakers, Apple has not ruled out any options at this stage.

Apple noted that its memory procurement costs for the first quarter (ending March) were higher than those for the fourth quarter of last year (ending December), and costs for the second quarter (ending June) increased significantly. Although inventory benefits offset some of the impact, the company expects memory costs to further increase in the third quarter (ending September).

When asked if it might purchase DRAM from China's CXMT or NAND flash memory from YMTC, Apple said it is still reviewing various supply sources. Introducing more suppliers is expected to improve the supply situation, but it is uncertain whether this will lower procurement prices.

Recent reports indicate that Apple is testing CXMT's DRAM products, suggesting that the Chinese memory manufacturer may enter Apple's supply chain in the future. However, the cooperation is still in the evaluation stage, and Apple has not formally announced its procurement decision.

The Financial Times previously quoted sources as saying that Apple had sought approval from the Trump administration to purchase DRAM from CXMT, which is currently on a US blacklist due to its alleged ties to the Chinese military.

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman recently revealed that Apple is communicating with the Trump administration, hoping to mitigate potential political backlash if it decides to purchase memory from CXMT or YMTC.

According to current plans, if Apple ultimately purchases memory from Chinese companies, the components will only be used in products sold in the Chinese market. However, this arrangement has not alleviated national security concerns in the US Congress.

A group of US lawmakers has urged Apple to abandon its plans to purchase Chinese memory and demanded that the company commit to not pursuing the plan by August 21. The lawmakers also requested that Apple fully disclose whether it has provided technical information to CXMT or YMTC and the specific content of such information.

Based on Apple's statements during the earnings call, the company's primary consideration is still ensuring a stable supply, and it has not excluded Chinese suppliers due to congressional pressure. However, whether Apple will ultimately proceed with the purchase remains to be seen.

items.title: SpaceX跌破IPO價20%創新低 Starship隔熱罩只是眾多挑戰之一
items.title_en: SpaceX Plunges 20% Below IPO Price, Hitting New Low as Starship Heat Shield Poses One of Many Challenges
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周五 (7/31) 跌至上市以來新低，較 6 周前的 IPO 價格下跌約 20%。令人意外的是，這檔股票上市首日曾如火箭般飆升，如今卻迅速回吐漲幅。
SpaceX 周五收跌 3.4%，報 108.37 美元，盤中一度跌至 107.01 美元。當日標普 500 指數與道瓊工業指數分別上漲 0.7% 及 0.5%。
截至周五開盤前，SpaceX 股價已較 135 美元的 IPO 價格下跌 17%。
對投資人而言，股價自然是目前最關心焦點。但對執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 來說，除了資本市場外，他還必須克服一連串技術難題，才能讓 SpaceX 實現其終極願景。
馬斯克希望 SpaceX 未來能讓旗下 Starship 這款大型、完全可重複使用的火箭，每年發射數千次。這項目標極具雄心，但要真正實現，仍有許多關鍵技術需要突破。
Starship 隔熱罩成關注焦點
目前討論最多的問題之一，就是保護 Starship 上段在重返大氣層時不被高溫燒毀的數千塊小型六角形隔熱磚。
Starship 的隔熱罩採用的是熱防護系統 (Thermal Protection System, TPS) 技術，其概念源自太空梭。這些隔熱磚由矽質陶瓷材料製成，可承受高達華氏 3,000 度 (約攝氏 1,650 度) 高溫。
任何返回地球的太空飛行器，其隔熱罩都難免受損，因此必須接受檢查。SpaceX 近幾次測試 Starship 的目標之一，就是蒐集隔熱罩數據，以持續改善技術與設計。
7 月稍早，在 Starship 第 13 次試飛中，上段火箭於印度洋濺落時並未爆炸，讓馬斯克相當振奮。測試後發生爆炸其實並不罕見，也不令人意外。由於火箭成功保存下來，SpaceX 得以取得更多隔熱罩數據。
不過，測試結束後，部分 NASA 科學家在 LinkedIn 發文質疑，目前的 TPS 技術是否足以支撐快速重複使用。
Charles Miller、Dan Rasky 及 Charles Camarda 寫道，「根據最近一次 Starship 飛行的數據，我們認為目前的熱防護系統 (TPS) 技術已走入死胡同，無法實現真正的完全且快速重複使用。」
他們指出，目前 TPS 雖然能正常運作，但每次飛行後，隔熱磚仍必須檢查與更換。這代表每艘 Starship 可能需要在維修廠停留數天甚至數周。
乍看之下這似乎不是大問題，但 Starship 的目標，是讓進入太空軌道的成本較目前已相當低成本、且可部分重複使用的 Falcon 9 火箭再降低 90% 以上。而快速重複使用正是 SpaceX 壓低成本的重要關鍵。
如果 Starship 無法按照規劃頻繁重複使用，SpaceX 就必須打造更多 Starship，才能達成每年數千次發射的目標。而建造更多 Starship，也可能拖慢公司發展太空通訊與 AI 相關業務的進度。
這些延誤對股市而言，是一項重大風險。目前 SpaceX 高達 1 兆美元的估值，很大程度建立在 Starship 能帶動公司營收快速成長的預期之上。
當然，SpaceX 本身也十分清楚隔熱罩仍需持續改良。馬斯克過去幾年來已多次在 X 平台談論這項技術。
此外，SpaceX 改善火箭技術的能力在業界幾乎無人能及。投資人或許相信，公司最終仍能成功解決隔熱罩問題，並持續提升隔熱技術。但投資人仍應密切關注熱防護系統的問題。
不過，分析認為，隔熱罩問題可能並非導致 SpaceX 股價下跌的主因。投資人目前更擔心的是公司估值偏高，以及 IPO 禁售期即將到期，早期投資人持股陸續解禁，市場流通股數增加，可能帶來額外賣壓。
paras_en: According to a report by Barron's, SpaceX (SPCX-US) stock price fell to a new low on Friday (7/31), down about 20% from its IPO price six weeks ago. Surprisingly, the stock, which had skyrocketed on its first day of trading, has quickly given up its gains.

SpaceX stock fell 3.4% to $108.37 on Friday, with an intraday low of $107.01. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively, on the same day. As of Friday's opening, SpaceX's stock price had already fallen 17% from its IPO price of $135.

For investors, the stock price is naturally the most pressing concern. However, for CEO Elon Musk, aside from the capital market, he must overcome a series of technical challenges to realize SpaceX's ultimate vision. Musk hopes that SpaceX's Starship, a large, fully reusable rocket, will be launched thousands of times a year.

One of the most discussed issues is the protection of the Starship's upper stage from high temperatures when re-entering the Earth's atmosphere, using thousands of small, hexagonal heat shield tiles. The Starship's heat shield uses Thermal Protection System (TPS) technology, which originated from the space shuttle. These heat shield tiles are made of silicon-based ceramic materials and can withstand temperatures of up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit (approximately 1,650 degrees Celsius).

Any spacecraft returning to Earth will inevitably damage its heat shield, requiring inspection. One of SpaceX's goals in recent Starship tests is to collect heat shield data to continuously improve the technology and design. In early July, during the 13th Starship test flight, the upper stage rocket did not explode when it splashed down in the Indian Ocean, which pleased Musk. Post-test explosions are not uncommon and not unexpected. Since the rocket was successfully preserved, SpaceX was able to obtain more heat shield data.

However, after the test, some NASA scientists questioned on LinkedIn whether the current TPS technology is sufficient to support rapid reuse. Charles Miller, Dan Rasky, and Charles Camarda wrote, 'Based on the recent Starship flight data, we believe that the current TPS technology has reached a dead end and cannot achieve true and rapid reuse.' They pointed out that while the current TPS works, the heat shield tiles still need to be inspected and replaced after each flight, which means each Starship may need to stay in the repair shop for several days or even weeks.

At first glance, this may not seem like a big problem, but Starship's goal is to reduce the cost of entering orbit by more than 90% compared to the already relatively low-cost and partially reusable Falcon 9 rocket. Rapid reuse is a key factor in SpaceX's plan to lower costs. If Starship cannot be reused frequently as planned, SpaceX will need to build more Starships to achieve its goal of thousands of launches per year. Building more Starships may also slow down the company's development of space communications and AI-related businesses.

These delays pose a significant risk to the stock market. SpaceX's valuation of over $1 trillion is largely based on the expectation that Starship will drive rapid revenue growth for the company. Of course, SpaceX is also aware that the heat shield needs to be continuously improved. Musk has discussed this technology on the X platform several times in recent years.

Additionally, SpaceX's ability to improve rocket technology is almost unmatched in the industry. Investors may believe that the company will eventually succeed in solving the heat shield problem and continue to enhance heat shield technology. However, investors should still closely monitor the TPS issue.

Analysts believe that the heat shield problem may not be the main reason for SpaceX's stock price decline. Investors are currently more concerned about the company's high valuation and the upcoming expiration of the IPO lock-up period, which may lead to additional selling pressure as early investors' shares are unlocked and the number of circulating shares increases.

items.title: AI燒錢潮迎來分水嶺！科技六巨頭一周市值波動合計近2兆美元
items.title_en: AI Spending Reaches a Turning Point as Tech Giants' Market Value Fluctuates by Nearly $2 Trillion
paras: 美國大型科技股本週在財報發布後走勢明顯分化，Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 單週累計增加近 1.5 兆美元市值；蘋果 (AAPL-US)、Meta (META-US) 與特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 則遭遇賣壓。投資人開始重新評估各家公司投入人工智慧 (AI) 的回報能力。
《CNBC》報導，截至週五，6 家已公布財報的科技巨頭市值劇烈波動：3 家公司合計增加近 1.5 兆美元，另外 3 家則蒸發約 4,420 億美元，漲跌金額合計接近 2 兆美元。
市場反應顯示，投資人並非全面看好或看壞 AI 支出，而是開始依據雲端成長、變現進度及資本效率，挑選可能率先勝出的企業。
其中，微軟本週市值增加超過 6,000 億美元，亞馬遜與 Google 母公司 Alphabet 也各自增加逾 4,000 億美元。三大雲端服務商均繳出強勁成長，讓市場相信，過去數年投入 AI 基礎設施的龐大資金，正逐漸轉化為實際需求與營收。
相較之下，Meta 財報公布後股價重挫，本週市值蒸發約 850 億美元。投資人仍不確定其 AI 基礎設施何時能形成明確的外部收入來源。
蘋果受到記憶體短缺及財測不如預期拖累，市值減少逾 3,500 億美元；特斯拉因自由現金流轉負並預告支出增加，市值縮水約 70 億美元。
傑富瑞全球科技、媒體與電信投資銀行共同主管 Jason Greenberg 表示，科技巨頭未來 12 個月的 AI 支出正朝近 8,000 億美元邁進。如今市場已不再質疑 AI 是否有人使用，或晶片與運算能力是否存在真實需求，而是詢問真正的問題：「長期獲利能否大到足以支撐如此龐大的投資？」
亞馬遜的財報成為市場信心的重要支撐。
亞馬遜第二季雲端部門 Amazon Web Services (AWS) 營收年增 37%，創 2021 年以來最快成長。由於 AWS 是亞馬遜承接大部分 AI 相關業務的核心平台，其成長速度也被視為衡量 AI 基礎設施需求的重要指標。
亞馬遜同時將 2026 年資本支出預估由 2,000 億美元上調至 2,200 億美元，顯示公司將繼續擴建 AI 基礎設施。儘管支出規模進一步提高，強勁的 AWS 成長仍緩解市場對投資超前需求的疑慮，推動亞馬遜週五股價收盤噴漲逾 15%。
Forrester 分析師 Tracy Woo 指出，AWS 的高速成長顯示，亞馬遜的基礎設施投資正在回應市場需求，而非遠遠跑在需求之前。不過，亞馬遜股價今年表現仍相對落後，年初迄今僅上漲約 4%。
蘋果面臨的情況則截然不同。雖然最新一季營收、獲利及 iPhone 銷售均優於市場預期，但公司預估本季營收將成長 9% 至 11%，低於分析師預期的 12%。蘋果將財測偏弱歸因於供應限制，特別是裝置所需記憶體嚴重短缺，以及晶片製造產能競爭升高。
供應壓力已促使蘋果調高 Mac 與 iPad 售價，分析師也預期 iPhone 今年可能跟進漲價。蘋果週五股價收盤下跌逾 7%，但年初迄今仍上漲約 23%。由於蘋果並未像其他科技巨頭一樣大幅擴張資本支出，先前一度被市場視為避開 AI 軍備競賽的替代性投資標的。
微軟與 Meta 的股價反差，也進一步突顯市場評價標準正在改變。微軟週四大漲 15%，Meta 則下跌 8%。兩家公司都持續擴大 AI 投資，但微軟已透過 Azure 雲端服務展現需求與變現能力，Meta 目前的 AI 基礎設施則主要服務內部業務，對外商業模式仍不夠清楚。
Gabelli 投資組合經理 Hendi Susanto 表示，投資人對 Meta 的耐心正在下降。雖然執行長祖克柏曾表示，公司正考慮讓 AI 基礎設施產生更多外部收入，但財報電話會議未提供明確進展，因而加深市場疑慮。
總言之，本輪財報季反映，華爾街對 AI 的關注焦點已從「是否值得投資」，轉向「誰能最快把投資變成獲利」。雲端業務高速成長的微軟、亞馬遜與 Alphabet 獲得資金追捧；Meta 與蘋果則因變現能見度及供應限制承受壓力，科技巨頭之間的估值差距也隨之擴大。
paras_en: The US tech giants' stock prices have shown a clear divergence after their earnings reports were released, with Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), and Microsoft (MSFT-US) seeing their market value increase by nearly $1.5 trillion in a single week, while Apple (AAPL-US), Meta (META-US), and Tesla (TSLA-US) faced selling pressure. Investors have started to reevaluate the returns on investment in artificial intelligence (AI) for each company.

According to CNBC, as of Friday, the market value of the six tech giants that have released their earnings reports has fluctuated sharply, with three companies seeing their market value increase by nearly $1.5 trillion and the other three losing around $442 billion, resulting in a total fluctuation of nearly $2 trillion.

The market reaction shows that investors are not uniformly optimistic or pessimistic about AI spending, but are instead selecting companies that may emerge victorious based on cloud growth, monetization progress, and capital efficiency.

Microsoft's market value increased by over $600 billion this week, while Amazon and Google's parent company Alphabet each increased by more than $400 billion. The three cloud service providers have all delivered strong growth, making the market believe that the massive investment in AI infrastructure over the past few years is gradually being converted into real demand and revenue.

In contrast, Meta's stock price plummeted after its earnings report was released, with its market value evaporating by around $85 billion this week. Investors are still uncertain when Meta's AI infrastructure will generate clear external revenue sources.

Apple's market value decreased by more than $350 billion due to memory shortages and lower-than-expected earnings forecasts, while Tesla's market value shrank by around $7 billion due to a decline in free cash flow and increased spending.

Jason Greenberg, co-head of global technology, media, and telecommunications investment banking at Jefferies, stated that the tech giants' AI spending over the next 12 months is expected to approach $800 billion. The market is no longer questioning whether AI is being used or whether there is real demand for chips and computing power, but is instead asking the real question: 'Will long-term profits be large enough to support such massive investment?'

Amazon's earnings report has become a key support for market confidence. Amazon Web Services (AWS) revenue grew 37% year-over-year in the second quarter, the fastest growth since 2021. As AWS is the core platform for Amazon's AI-related businesses, its growth rate is also seen as an important indicator of the demand for AI infrastructure.

Amazon also raised its 2026 capital expenditure estimate from $200 billion to $220 billion, indicating that the company will continue to expand its AI infrastructure. Despite the increased spending, the strong growth of AWS has alleviated market concerns about investment demand, driving Amazon's stock price up by over 15% on Friday.

Forrester analyst Tracy Woo pointed out that AWS's high growth shows that Amazon's infrastructure investment is responding to market demand, rather than running ahead of it. However, Amazon's stock price has still underperformed this year, with a gain of only around 4% since the beginning of the year.

Apple, on the other hand, faces a different situation. Although its latest quarterly revenue, profit, and iPhone sales all exceeded market expectations, the company's revenue forecast for the current quarter is expected to grow 9-11%, lower than analysts' expectations of 12%. Apple attributed the weak forecast to supply constraints, particularly the severe shortage of memory required for devices, as well as increased competition for chip manufacturing capacity.

The supply pressure has led Apple to raise the prices of Macs and iPads, and analysts expect iPhone prices to follow suit this year. Apple's stock price fell by over 7% on Friday, but is still up around 23% since the beginning of the year. As Apple has not expanded its capital expenditure significantly like other tech giants, it was once seen as an alternative investment target for avoiding the AI arms race.

The contrast between Microsoft's and Meta's stock prices further highlights the changing market evaluation standards. Microsoft surged 15% on Thursday, while Meta fell 8%. Both companies are continuing to expand their AI investments, but Microsoft has demonstrated demand and monetization capabilities through its Azure cloud service, while Meta's current AI infrastructure primarily serves internal businesses, with an unclear external commercial model.

Gabelli investment portfolio manager Hendi Susanto stated that investors' patience with Meta is wearing thin. Although CEO Zuckerberg has said that the company is considering generating more external revenue from its AI infrastructure, the earnings call did not provide clear progress, deepening market concerns.

In summary, this earnings season reflects that Wall Street's focus on AI has shifted from 'whether it's worth investing' to 'who can turn investments into profits the fastest.' Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet, which have high-growth cloud businesses, have received funding support, while Meta and Apple face pressure due to limited visibility on monetization and supply constraints, resulting in a widening valuation gap between the tech giants.

items.title: SpaceX首份財報倒數 大摩維持300美元目標價：最危險時刻來臨 AI價值仍遭低估
items.title_en: SpaceX's First Quarterly Report Looms: Morgan Stanley Keeps $300 Target, Warns of Most Dangerous Moment; AI Value Still Underestimated
paras: SpaceX (SPCX-US)將於 8 月 4 日公布首次公開募股 (IPO) 後首份季度財報，在股價自歷史高點大幅回落、且大規模限售股即將解禁之際，市場高度關注公司能否透過財報與管理層展望重振投資人信心。摩根士丹利指出，這次財報可能是 SpaceX 上市以來面臨的「最危險時刻」，真正左右市場情緒的未必是財務數字，而是管理層對 AI、星鏈 (Starlink) 及星艦 (Starship) 未來發展的最新說法。
SpaceX 於 6 月 12 日以每股 135 美元掛牌上市，股價一度衝上 225 美元，市值最高突破 3 兆美元，超越亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與微軟(MSFT-US)。然而，在市場重新評估估值及 AI 題材後，股價已回落至約 112 美元，較高點下跌約五成，使這份財報更受到市場矚目。
除了財報本身外，市場另一焦點是 8 月 6 日即將到來的限售股解禁。屆時約 9.115 億股股票將符合解禁條件，以目前市值估算約相當於 1,000 億美元股票可能流入市場，意味著 SpaceX 恐面臨龐大賣壓，也可能放大財報發布前後的股價波動。
摩根士丹利預估，SpaceX 第二季營收約 67.5 億美元，調整後每股虧損 0.35 美元。該行預估，第二季 Starlink 全球消費者用戶數將達 1,200 萬戶，每位用戶平均每月收入 (ARPU) 約 65.5 美元。
不過，摩根士丹利認為，市場真正關注的是管理層對未來業務的評論，而非短期財務數據。該行預期，SpaceX 法說會風格將類似特斯拉 (TSLA-US)，不會提供過多量化財測，而是聚焦星艦開發時程、AI 算力部署速度，以及 Grok 與 Cursor 模型的整體發展方向。
分析師表示，投資人尤其希望了解 Starlink 企業客戶拓展進度、公司是否釋出 2027 年前 AI 運算能力突破 2GW 的擴產藍圖，以及 SpaceX AI 與 Cursor 共同開發 AI 模型的最新進展。
摩根士丹利指出，由於 Cursor 收購案預計本季稍晚才會完成，因此第二季財報預料不會揭露該交易的具體財務貢獻，但市場仍期待管理層說明整體 AI 布局策略。
儘管近期股價大幅修正，摩根士丹利仍維持 SpaceX 目標價 300 美元，認為目前市場仍低估其 AI 業務價值。
該行估算，SpaceX 估值中，太空業務價值約每股 8 美元，網路與 Starlink 業務約 128 美元，X 平台及 Grok AI 約 12 美元，企業 AI 業務則高達 152 美元，占整體估值比重超過一半，顯示 AI 仍是未來主要成長動能。
除了財報之外，市場另一項潛在利多來自預計 8 月底至 9 月初執行的 Starship Flight 14 飛行任務。若此次任務成功完成上級艙回收，將代表 Starship 在完全可重複使用火箭技術上取得重大突破，進一步提升市場對 SpaceX 長期商業模式的信心。
不過，在短期內，市場情緒仍偏向保守。摩根士丹利透露，近期舉辦的投資人會議中，超過三分之二的與會投資人看空 SpaceX 年底前股價表現，主要擔憂財報缺乏足夠催化劑，加上解禁股票帶來龐大供給，將持續壓抑股價。
報告指出，即將解禁的早期投資人多數已累積數十倍投資報酬，即使目前股價較高點回落，仍具有強烈獲利了結誘因。因此，在財報與解禁雙重因素交織下，SpaceX 短線股價波動性恐明顯升高，市場將密切關注管理層是否能透過 AI、Starlink 及 Starship 發展藍圖，重新凝聚投資人對公司長期成長的信心。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) will release its first quarterly report after its IPO on August 4, as its share price has fallen sharply from historic highs and a large block of restricted shares is about to unlock. The market is closely watching whether the earnings release and management outlook can revive investor confidence. Morgan Stanley says this report could be the "most dangerous moment" SpaceX has faced since going public, and that what will truly sway sentiment may not be the numbers themselves but management's latest comments on AI, Starlink and Starship development.

SpaceX listed on June 12 at $135 per share, briefly soaring to $225 and pushing its market cap past $3 trillion, surpassing Amazon (AMZN-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US). After the market re‑evaluated the valuation and AI narrative, the price has slipped to around $112, roughly a 50% drop from the peak, making this earnings release even more closely watched.

Beyond the earnings, another market focus is the upcoming unlock of restricted shares on August 6. About 911.5 million shares will become eligible for sale, which at current market values represents roughly $100 billion of stock that could flow into the market, potentially creating massive selling pressure and amplifying price swings around the earnings announcement.

Morgan Stanley estimates SpaceX’s Q2 revenue at about $6.75 billion, with an adjusted loss of $0.35 per share. The firm projects Starlink’s global consumer subscriber base to reach 12 million in Q2, with an average revenue per user (ARPU) of about $65.5 per month.

However, Morgan Stanley believes the market is really interested in management’s commentary on future business, not short‑term financial metrics. The firm expects SpaceX’s earnings call to resemble Tesla’s (TSLA-US) style—providing limited quantitative guidance and focusing on Starship development timelines, AI compute deployment speed, and the overall direction of the Grok and Cursor models.

Analysts say investors especially want to hear about Starlink’s enterprise customer expansion, whether the company will unveil a roadmap to exceed 2 GW of AI compute capacity before 2027, and the latest progress on AI models jointly developed by SpaceX AI and Cursor.

Morgan Stanley notes that because the Cursor acquisition is expected to close later this quarter, the Q2 results likely won’t disclose the transaction’s specific financial contribution, but the market still expects management to outline the broader AI strategy.
Despite the recent sharp price correction, Morgan Stanley maintains a $300 price target for SpaceX, arguing the market still undervalues its AI business potential.

The firm breaks down SpaceX’s valuation: roughly $8 per share for the space business, about $128 for the network and Starlink business, $12 for the X platform and Grok AI, and as much as $152 for the enterprise AI segment—over half of the total valuation—showing AI remains the primary growth engine.

In addition to the earnings, a potential catalyst could come from the planned Starship Flight 14 mission slated for late August to early September. If the mission successfully recovers the upper stage, it would mark a major breakthrough in fully reusable rocket technology and boost confidence in SpaceX’s long‑term commercial model.

In the short term, market sentiment remains cautious. Morgan Stanley disclosed that in a recent investor meeting, more than two‑thirds of participants were bearish on SpaceX’s stock performance through year‑end, citing concerns that the earnings report lacks sufficient catalysts and that the large share unlock will keep supply pressure high, suppressing the price.

The report notes that many early investors whose shares are about to unlock have already realized multiples of their original investment, so even with the price now below its peak they have strong incentives to take profits. Consequently, the combination of earnings and the share unlock is likely to increase short‑term volatility, and the market will watch closely whether management can rally investor confidence in the company’s long‑term growth through AI, Starlink and Starship development plans.

items.title: WSJ：川普下令再度轟炸伊朗！最快周末展開、持續數日
items.title_en: WSJ: Trump Orders New Strikes on Iran, Possibly Starting This Weekend
paras: 《華爾街日報》引述美國官員報導，美國總統川普已下令對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，行動最快可能於本週末展開，並持續數日，目的是加大軍事壓力，迫使德黑蘭屈服。
川普週五在大衛營舉行的內閣會議上表示，美軍將對伊朗展開「非常猛烈」的攻擊。他認為，只要持續施加足夠壓力，伊朗政權最終將無法承受，並被迫重返談判桌。
這番強硬表態與川普本週稍早的說法形成對比。川普先前宣稱，美伊正進行「非常友好的談判」，因此美方得以暫停軍事行動；但伊朗隨後突襲駐約旦美軍，促使美國週三發動報復性攻擊，美伊緊張局勢再度升高。
美國官員透露，川普近幾週私下多次向幕僚抱怨伊朗方面「瘋狂」，並認為先前達成的臨時和平協議毫無實質意義。
他週五也公開批評伊朗外交官員「非常不守信用」，指控德黑蘭屢次違背承諾，因此需要更猛烈的軍事行動，才能瓦解伊朗的抵抗意志。
伊朗方面同樣對談判屢次破局感到不滿。
伊朗官員認為，美伊之間缺乏基本互信，而川普每次以動武相威脅，都會進一步削弱雙方關係及外交解決的可能性。伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊週四則誓言，在美軍發動報復性空襲後恢復對美方的攻擊。
隨著美伊戰爭進入第六個月，雙方立場仍未出現鬆動。川普持續要求伊朗放棄核計畫，並交出對荷姆茲海峽的控制權；德黑蘭則拒絕在這兩項核心議題上讓步。
川普正在評估的軍事選項之一，是展開為期兩週的密集空襲，以削弱伊朗的飛彈能力。不過，美國軍方顧問已警告，彈藥庫存持續下降，可能限制美軍擴大或延長攻勢的能力。
部分美國官員認為，伊朗可能繼續拖延談判，押注川普最終會在美國國內反戰與政治壓力升高之下，逐步放棄長期軍事行動。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal, citing US officials, reported that US President Trump has ordered a new round of attacks on Iran, which could start as early as this weekend and last for several days, aiming to increase military pressure on Tehran to surrender.

Trump stated at a cabinet meeting at Camp David on Friday that the US military would launch a "very severe" attack on Iran, believing that if enough pressure is applied, the Iranian regime will eventually be unable to withstand it and will be forced back to the negotiating table.

This tough stance contrasts with Trump's earlier statement that the US and Iran were engaged in "very friendly" negotiations, which allowed the US to pause military action; however, Iran's surprise attack on US troops in Jordan prompted the US to launch a retaliatory strike on Wednesday, escalating tensions between the two countries again.

US officials revealed that Trump has privately complained to his staff several times in recent weeks about Iran's "craziness" and believes that the temporary peace agreement reached earlier was meaningless.

On Friday, Trump also publicly criticized Iranian diplomats as "very untrustworthy" and accused Tehran of repeatedly breaking its promises, necessitating more severe military action to break Iran's will to resist.

Iranian officials are also dissatisfied with the repeated breakdown of negotiations, believing that the lack of basic trust between the US and Iran, combined with Trump's repeated threats of military action, will further undermine the relationship and the possibility of a diplomatic solution.

As the US-Iran war enters its sixth month, neither side has shown any signs of compromise. Trump continues to demand that Iran abandon its nuclear program and relinquish control of the Strait of Hormuz, while Tehran refuses to concede on these two core issues.

One of the military options being considered by Trump is a two-week intensive air campaign to weaken Iran's missile capabilities. However, US military advisors have warned that the depletion of ammunition stocks could limit the ability to expand or prolong the offensive.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元7月跌逾1% Fed與通膨數據釋雜訊 日元連兩日強升
items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Falls Over 1% in July as Fed and Inflation Data Send Mixed Signals, Yen Rises for Second Consecutive Day
paras: 美元周五 (7/31) 下跌，7 月累計下跌逾 1%，創下 4 月以來最差單月表現。美元本周大部分跌幅出現在聯準會 (Fed) 利率決議後，外匯市場開始質疑 Fed 是否有能力有效壓制通膨，相關疑慮也反映在近期美國公債遭大舉拋售、殖利率大幅攀升。
另一方面，日元連續第二個交易日強勢升值。市場持續懷疑日本政府再度出手干預匯市，協助日元自兌美元 40 年低點反彈。這波干預預期，也掩蓋了日本央行 (BoJ) 如市場預期維持利率不變的消息。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 報 99.83，7 月累計下跌 1.3%。
美國 7 月公布、反映 6 月物價表現的通膨數據，包括消費者物價指數 (CPI)、生產者物價指數(PPI) 及 Fed 偏好的通膨指標──個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)，皆低於市場預期。
不過，這波通膨降溫主要受惠於 6 月全球油價下跌。隨著中東外交局勢惡化，油價於 7 月再度走高，使市場對通膨的看法在 Fed 周三利率決議前出現明顯轉變。
雖然市場普遍預期聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 將維持利率不變，但近期油價大漲，使市場對升息的預期高於近年同期水準。最終 FOMC 決定維持聯邦基金利率不變，但有三位官員投下反對票，主張升息 1 碼。
市場原本期待 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 能在記者會上提出更具體的抗通膨策略或未來政策方向，但最終並未獲得明確指引。
美國公債殖利率更直接反映市場的不安情緒，7 月大幅走高，實際上已發揮類似升息的效果。
周五，三位投下反對票的官員分別發表聲明，進一步說明支持升息的理由，其中持續偏高的通膨是共同關鍵因素。Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 José Torres 表示，「如果 Fed 在下次會議仍不升息，固定收益市場近期的不滿情緒恐怕只會進一步惡化。」
他指出，目前「債市義警」對 Fed 感到困惑，因華許從過去被視為最鷹派的成員，如今立場已轉向委員會中間派。
Torres 表示，「這點從周三會議就能看出來。三位官員投票支持升息，但華許似乎希望繼續拖延，同時強調前任 Fed 讓通膨過長時間高於目標。」
他進一步指出，「美國公債市場正大聲告訴 Fed，不可能兩全其美。如果 9 月仍不升息，長天期公債市場將面臨更嚴重的後果。」
歐元 7 月上漲 1%
歐元兌美元小漲 0.1%，至 1.1537 美元，7 月累計上漲約 1%。
稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區 7 月整體通膨率由 6 月的 2.8% 升至 2.9%，主要受到油價反彈帶動。扣除食品與能源的核心通膨升至 2.5%。服務業通膨升至 3.3%。
再加上第二季歐元區 GDP 成長優於預期，市場更加相信歐洲央行 (ECB) 可能於 9 月升息。
目前金融市場預估，至明年初前 ECB 累計升息幅度將超過 2 碼，但經濟學家也提醒，就業市場降溫與食品通膨放緩，可能限制央行進一步大幅升息的空間。
日元連兩日走強
日元在周三大漲後，周五再度升值，美元兌日元創下 2024 年 8 月初以來最差單周表現。
《日經亞洲》報導，日本政府確實於前一天進場買進日元、賣出美元。
此外，市場人士指出，美國主管機關也曾進行匯率詢價，這通常被視為官方可能介入匯市的前兆。
